notes:
Workday board, agent-less via SYS-13 pre_filter_urls. Costa Rica is carried by the standard Workday facet ?locationCountry=99abe7e6bb3f4c108aebebf01a369ec5 — the same CR uuid used by Cloudera, Babel, Cohesity and LSEG. The authoritative count comes from Workday's own API: POST /wday/cxs/medtronic/MedtronicCareers/jobs with appliedFacets.locationCountry=[<CR uuid>] reports total=14 (13 Alajuela Coyol roles plus one multi-location 'Global Supply Chain Program Manager' whose locationsText reads '3 Locations' and legitimately includes Costa Rica).

Prefix: Workday detail URLs use /details/<slug> but the LISTING renders /job/<loc>/<slug> anchors, so derive_path_prefix on any sample gives a prefix that matches nothing and LinkRule(path_prefix='/es/MedtronicCareers/job') is required. Every Workday entry in the corpus does the same.

Why agent-less rather than hooks.filter_already_applied: the board renders a visible 'Ubicación' filter and the DOM agent interacts with it even under the hook — one observed run opened the filter, clicked 'Croacia' (Croatia), then self-corrected to Costa Rica. Measured 14 / 14 / 0 across three hook-path runs; the 0 is the agent destroying the pre-applied filter. The agent-less path removes the LLM from the loop and measured 14 / 14 / 14. This is the doola rationale and the LSEG precedent (same platform, same CR facet).
